PrimeIntervalBase::build scans x = (lo + k) mod p for k < 2^t and delegates the points to bits_factor_base ((lo mod p + k) mod p, the same set), so the base is exactly the carriers of [L, L + 2^T) mod p, ascending x, one column per abscissa, coef 1 for (x, min(y, p-y)) and r-1 for its negative, a single point when y = 0: the conventions of abscissa_factor_base/prime_factor_base, which curve25519_family uses with pkm-semaev bits. Charging equals prime_factor_base: abscissae_scanned = legendre_symbols = 2^t, sqrt_solves = #(Legendre >= 0), count_index_build(a + n, a); bits_factor_base charges nothing itself, so no double count. Parameter checks: unknown key, t = 0, t >= 64 (short-circuits before the shift), 2^t >= p, lo >= p, empty interval. from_spec: the prime-interval arm precedes the generic bits arm, reads (t, lo) from the base, rejects a differing bits= or lo=, accepts equal ones; Membership::Bits in prepare checks (x - lo) mod p < 2^t, consistent with the base under wraparound. Registered in prime_base_for, dump_factor_base and the factor_base help string; ic_boundary.rs change is visibility only (pub(crate) count_index_build).
